production.notes: Home Pro Sync v1.0.0 Public Stable Baseline Release.

targeted_test.notes: Home Pro Sync v1.3.0 Beta: Critical battery & performance optimizations (render loop fix, adaptive background polling), edge-to-edge safe area scaling, ESP32 firmware safety fail-safes (15s sensor heartbeat timeout, division-by-zero protection), Admin PIN recovery ('8000' / 'maudible'), and high-speed single-connection background APK updater.
